in_marathi.name: Vinesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vinesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vinesh is a Hindu baby name. In Sanskrit, the meaning of the name Vinesh is 'Conqueror, Victor'. The name Vinesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vin' which means 'Conqueror, Victor'. This name is often given to a baby boy to inspire strength and victory in him.
